set.body:
Objective
Admit/reject/explain reuse from exact value lineage, metric, target/preparation scope, parameters, randomness and fidelity. Optimize low-rank queries and equal-weight all-distinct pairing only under stated laws.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements FND-09, REL-01, REL-02, PERF-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
implementation; scientific/numerical compiler dependency DAG; relational query cache adapters. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M2.03, M2.04, M2.05, M1.05. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Same locator with changed content rejects stale values; new display title changes no numerical work.
2. New RSA model reuses only compatible retained geometry and changes comparison/multiplicity state; changed folds/targets invalidate the affected descendants.
3. Low-rank trace and sum-product-minus-self rewrites match independent enumeration, including cancellation-prone fixtures.
4. Dense metrics and changed ROI covariance invalidate unjustified feature-additive caches; cost/output retention is bounded.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M2.06: Implement dependency-checked query reuse and scoped sufficient-statistic rewrites
